why_ai: Machine translation already does the core work, leaving post-editing that AI keeps absorbing.
why_clarity: Segments recur by the million with codified error typologies, though market outcomes go unmeasured.
why_digital: Source files in, translated files out, sourced from linguists anywhere.

why_ai: Capturing post-editing effort is pure instrumentation of an environment that already logs everything.
why_clarity: Keystrokes, pauses and revisions give objective effort data per segment.
why_digital: Translation environment telemetry in, effort data out.

why_ai: Extraction, round-tripping and connectors are recurring engineering problems automation removes.
why_clarity: A file either round-trips without breaking or it does not, across recurring formats.
why_digital: Client files and systems in, reinserted content out, all software.

why_ai: Linking translations to conversions is an analytics problem, though attribution needs some judgement.
why_clarity: Conversion and resolution are measurable, but no agreed method links them to translations yet.
why_digital: Translations and client analytics in, outcome comparisons out.

why_ai: Post-editing machine output is the production mode AI improvement keeps shrinking.
why_clarity: Segments repeat endlessly, but the rate's fairness is a disputed, unmeasured assumption.
why_digital: Machine output edited on screens by remote linguists.

why_ai: Deduplicating, routing and propagating linguist questions is high-volume mechanical coordination.
why_clarity: Each query is answered once and propagated, a fully defined and repeatable flow.
why_digital: Questions and answers move as messages between remote parties.

why_ai: Rates must survive negotiation among parties with opposed interests, a human commercial settlement.
why_clarity: No agreed method exists, and whether a structure holds is learned over contract cycles.
why_digital: Pricing designed and negotiated remotely across a global supply chain.

why_ai: Concatenated strings, hardcoded formats and idioms are defects automated checkers catch directly.
why_clarity: Known defect patterns are checkable instantly in every source string.
why_digital: Source content in, flagged defects out, all on screens.

why_ai: Quality scoring and curation of memories and glossaries is exactly what language models do well.
why_clarity: Contradictions and obsolete entries are checkable, though brand voice is partly taste.
why_digital: Translation memories and glossaries are purely digital assets.

why_ai: Orchestrating thirty pipelines with escalations is coordination agent software can take over.
why_clarity: On-time release across every language is a clear, repeated, quickly checked goal.
why_digital: Pipelines, schedules and messages managed remotely across time zones.

why_ai: Error-typology scoring is being taken over by automated quality estimation, though style calls remain.
why_clarity: Two reviewers score the same translation differently and nothing validates either.
why_digital: Translations reviewed on screens by remote language specialists.
